title.justification: The title 'Value Preserving State-Action Abstractions' is clearly stated at both the beginning of the paper and within the document.

analysis.description: The paper introduces a formalism for analyzing value loss in state-action abstractions in reinforcement learning, specifically defining ε-relative options. It establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for the preservation of near-optimal behavior in finite Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and explores hierarchical compositions of these abstractions.

type.justification: The focus of the paper is on developing a theory and formalisms for analyzing state-action abstractions in reinforcement learning, rather than conducting empirical experiments or studies.
type.quote: The primary contribution of this work is new analysis clarifying which combinations of state abstractions ( ) and options (O) preserve representation of near-optimal policies in finite Markovian environments.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving reinforcement learning through the use of state-action abstractions.
name.quote: In reinforcement learning (RL), one powerful class of such structures takes the form of abstractions, either of state(what are the relevant properties of the world?) or action (what correlated, long-horizon sequences of actions are useful?).

name.justification: The paper specifically deals with preserving optimal behavior in finite Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and ε-relative options are defined with respect to these.
name.quote: necessary and sufficient conditions for ε-relative options to preserve near-optimal behavior in any finite Markov Decision Process.

name.justification: The paper discusses creating hierarchical compositions of ε-relative options to induce hierarchical abstractions that preserve policy representations, a core concept in hierarchical reinforcement learning.
name.quote: Indeed, this represents the strongest existing result for how to construct value-preserving hierarchies based on approximate knowledge.
